Panoptic is a perpetual options protocol that operates without an expiry date. Panoptic is built on Uniswap v3 positions. Panoptic runs as smart contracts on the Ethereum public blockchain.

Perpetual Protocol is a decentralized perpetual futures exchange. Perpetual Protocol runs as smart contracts on a public blockchain. Perpetual Protocol uses a virtual automated market maker in its first version.

GMX is a decentralized perpetual and spot trading exchange. GMX operates on the Arbitrum and Avalanche blockchains. GMX uses the GLP liquidity pool as the counterparty to trader positions.
